gates.name: Run Pester tests
gates.detail: Invoke-Pester -Path tools -Output Detailed -PassThru: Tests Passed: 250, Failed: 13, Skipped: 22. All 13 failures are the identical root cause across Update-DesignProjection.Tests.ps1 (1) and Wait-PullRequestCheck.Tests.ps1 (12): 'CommandNotFoundException: Could not find Command gh'. The gh CLI binary is not installed in this sandbox (this session uses the GitHub MCP server instead of gh); these tests shell out to gh directly rather than through a mockable wrapper reachable without the binary present. No file this PR touches is under tools/, and the failures are unrelated to session-lifecycle/store code — the same 13 would fail on main in this same sandbox.
